checks.text: On first load with no data, the page shows the heading "Simple CRM", the text "No customers yet", and the tab labelled "Customers" is active.

Clicking the button "Add customer" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Name" with "Ada Lovelace", the field labelled "Email" with "ada@example.com", and the field labelled "Company" with "Analytical Engines", then clicking "Save" adds a list item containing "Ada Lovelace" and "ada@example.com", and the text "No customers yet" is gone.

With the customer "Ada Lovelace" present, clicking the button "Log interaction" on that row opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Type" with "Call", the field labelled "Notes" with "Discussed pricing", and clicking "Save" adds an interaction entry under the customer that contains "Call" and "Discussed pricing".
Typing "Ada" in the search field labelled "Search customers" filters the list so that only the row containing "Ada Lovelace" is visible; typing "Zzz" shows the text "No customers match".
Clicking the select labelled "Filter by status" and choosing "Lead" hides the row for "Ada Lovelace" (whose status is "Customer") and shows the text "No customers match".

Clicking the button "Edit" on the row for "Ada Lovelace" opens the form pre-filled. Changing the field labelled "Company" to "Babbage Labs" and clicking "Save" updates the row to show "Babbage Labs" and no longer shows "Analytical Engines".
Clicking the button "Delete" on the row for "Ada Lovelace" removes that row from the list; with no other customers, the text "No customers yet" reappears.

Clicking the tab labelled "Interactions" shows a table with the header "Date", "Customer", "Type", and "Notes". With the interaction logged in A3, the table contains a row with "Ada Lovelace", "Call", and "Discussed pricing".
Reload keeps the customer "Ada Lovelace" with company "Babbage Labs" and the interaction "Discussed pricing" visible in the Interactions tab.
